name: claudesteps-monorepo
description: Orchestrate Claude agents, skills & workflows for structured AI development.

scripts.clean: rm -rf packages/*/out packages/*/out-itest packages/*/out-test packages/*/out-unit packages/*/tsconfig.tsbuildinfo
scripts.compile-all: npm run compile && npm run build-webview
scripts.build: npm run clean && npm run compile-all && node scripts/package-vsix.mjs
scripts.publish:marketplace: npm run package:vsix && vsce publish --packagePath claudesteps.vsix
scripts.pretest: npm run compile && npm run lint
scripts.lint: eslint packages/*/src packages/core/test packages/extension/test packages/webview/test --ext ts
scripts.test:unit: npm run compile && npm run compile:test && node --test packages/core/out/test/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:unit-ext: npm run compile && npm run compile:unit-ext && node --test packages/extension/out-unit/test/unit/*.test.js
scripts.test:webview: npm run compile && npm run compile:webview-test && node --test packages/webview/out-test/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:integration: npm run compile-all && npm run compile:itest && node packages/extension/out-itest/test/runIntegration.js
scripts.test: npm run test:unit && npm run test:unit-ext && npm run test:webview
scripts.test:coverage: npm run compile && npm run compile:test && c8 node --test packages/core/out/test/test/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage-ext: npm run compile && npm run compile:unit-ext && c8 --config .c8rc.extension.json node --test packages/extension/out-unit/test/unit/*.test.js
scripts.test:coverage-webview: npm run compile && npm run compile:webview-test && c8 --config .c8rc.webview.json node --test packages/webview/out-test/test/*.test.js
